body.message:
I’m really unhappy with your poor service. Since the day I moved into this house, the ceiling has been leaking. You already sent 3–4 people, and the problem is still not fixed. The whole house smells terrible because of the bathroom ceiling leak.

From day one, I also told you that you only gave us one access card while we are two people living here, and we need another one. Until now, nothing has been done.

When you expect me to pay the rent on time, I will remember all of these issues as well.
